scripts.dev: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently --names api,worker,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @arus/api" "npm run dev:worker -w @arus/api" "npm run dev -w @arus/web"
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @arus/domain && npm run build -w @arus/api && npm run build -w @arus/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run db:generate && tsc --noEmit -p prisma/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:integration: dotenv -e .env -- env RUN_DATABASE_INTEGRATION_TESTS=true npm run test:integration -w @arus/api
scripts.demo:reset: dotenv -e .env -- env RESET_DEMO_DATA=true prisma db seed && npm run demo:verify
scripts.demo:verify: npm run build -w @arus/domain && dotenv -e .env -- tsx scripts/verify-demo-seed.ts
